description: Unit tests for scoring functions. Tests: (1) score_to_verdict at boundary values (75,74,60,59,50,49,35,34,20,19) (2) compute_trust_score with known inputs returns expected output (3) weights sum to 1.0 (4) all VERDICTS in VERDICT_THRESHOLDS (5) attestation expiry days are positive integers. Uses stdlib unittest. Run: python3 -m pytest tests/test_scoring.py -v. No daemon.
